details.description: Llama 3.2 90B Vision Instruct is the largest multimodal model in Meta's Llama 3.2 family, released September 25, 2024. It pairs a separately trained vision adapter with cross-attention layers on top of the Llama 3.1 text-only model, letting it reason over images and text together for tasks such as visual question answering, document understanding, and chart reading. Text-only prompts support eight languages, but Meta states image-plus-text prompts are English only. Amazon Bedrock's model card lists this model's lifecycle as Legacy, with a listed EOL date of July 7, 2026 that has already passed as of this research date.
advantages: Meta reports 90.1 ANLS on DocVQA and 85.5% relaxed accuracy on ChartQA (chain-of-thought), per its model card.
Meta reports 60.3% micro-average accuracy on the MMMU multimodal reasoning benchmark and 78.1% accuracy on VQAv2, per its model card.
Meta reports 86.0% macro-average accuracy on MMLU for its text-only capabilities, inherited from the underlying Llama 3.1 text-only model, per its model card.
Officially supports 8 text-only languages: English, German, French, Italian, Portuguese, Hindi, Spanish, and Thai, per Meta's model card.
disadvantages: Image-plus-text prompts are English only; the other seven supported languages apply to text-only use, per Meta's model card.
Knowledge cutoff of December 2023, per Meta's model card.
Fireworks AI's hosted listing states the model does not support structured function calling or tool use on its platform.
Amazon Bedrock's model card lists this model's lifecycle as Legacy, with a listed EOL date of July 7, 2026 that has already passed as of this research date (2026-09-24).
use_cases: Document understanding and reading of charts, diagrams, and scanned documents
Multilingual text-only assistant chat in the eight supported languages

notes: Catalog's max_input_tokens/max_output_tokens (16384) are lower than the 128K context / 4K max output that Meta's model card and AWS Bedrock both state for this model; kept the catalog's figures per instructions. Amazon Bedrock's own model card (fetched 2026-09-24) lists lifecycle as Legacy with Model EOL date July 7, 2026, already past as of this research date. Removed 'Llama 3.1 70B' as the stated backbone size: the model/vision cards, the HF page and Meta's Llama 3.2 announcement post all say only that Llama 3.2-Vision is built on the Llama 3.1 text-only model, without stating which Llama 3.1 size (8B/70B) corresponds to the 11B/90B vision sizes.
